decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line in the firm's core underground-equipment business, its market potential is still too uncertain to justify abandonment after only one year, while the option value of learning from early customers and leveraging existing engineering and service capabilities remains high.

These dump trucks fit the same underground mining customer base and capability set, and given long industrial sales cycles and limited evidence so far, management would likely keep the line on the market to preserve the option of scaling it if adoption improves.
